title: Australian Mango Sushi
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional sushi, featuring Australian mango and kissed sushi rice.
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine sushi vinegar and a pinch of salt. Heat over low heat until dissolved.
Allow sushi rice to cool, then mix with vinegar mixture.
Cut Australian mango into small pieces.
Cut kissed seaweed sheets into desired size.
Assemble sushi rolls with a layer of sushi rice, a layer of mango, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Roll sushi tightly and slice into individual pieces.
